title: Chesapeake Bay impact
summary: About 35 million years ago a comet or asteroid struck the shallow shelf of what is now southeastern Virginia, leaving the Chesapeake Bay impact crater, described by ASU as the largest impact crater in the US. USGS reports a 90-km-diameter structure; ASU gives a 25-mile diameter. It lies buried beneath the bay, where a 1,766-m-deep test hole was drilled in 2005 and 2006.

uncertainty.note: Both pages say about 35 million years ago. Years are Ma with no 1950 offset.
